description: Sends a draft's invites (mails the guests, spends one credit) — the exact Send the draft's own review page runs, for a draft_id from create_event. Spends one autopilot credit (or a Plus subscription slot). Needs the send permission; cannot be undone. If the organizer's account has no name yet, pass organizer_name (guests see it).

organizer_name.description: The name guests should see, only needed when the organizer's account has no name yet. Ask the organizer; never guess it from their email.

name: send_invites
